fact: The 2021 Burkina Faso Demographic and Health Survey report, published August 2023, gives the proportion of individuals using the internet (SDG 17.8.1) as 27.3 per cent, among the women aged 15-49 and men aged 15-59 interviewed in 2021.
title: Enquête Démographique et de Santé 2021, Burkina Faso (EDSBF-V)
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INSD) et ICF
